correctness.rationale: Unique common-neighbor centers for every horizontal face of size at least two, valid descending-size elementary free-face pairs, exact residual categorical bipartite double cover and its graph cycle ranks are proved uniformly. Group-invariant orbit matching supplies equivariant equivalence. Independent finite checker verifies every face and removal for 613 four-cycle-free labeled graphs through five vertices and additional examples, while the cube tests the sharp boundary.

Matsushita 2021 asserts isomorphic cover graphs imply isomorphic neighborhoods; it does not identify an unrelated complex with a cover graph.

value.rationale: Uniform constructive equivariant simplicial collapse gives a canonical graph spine and exact integral group topology for arbitrary-degree C4-free graph prisms, whose squares overlap at every nonleaf rung and thus evade established edge-disjoint-square theorems; square base changes the homotopy dimension, making the scope boundary meaningful.
